limitations: Independent AI visual pass, not an independent human measurement and not machine-calibrated ground truth.
Viewed only the supplied original PNGs, manifest, and crops derived from those PNGs. No previous endpoint labels, inspection, draft, example, or audit files were read.
Target boat numbers were supplied separately to disambiguate frames containing two boats. Clothing colors agree, but numerals are not legible in every frame.
Coordinates are original-image pixels (origin top left), estimated visually from 2x crops with 25 px grid. No subpixel or exact-pixel accuracy is claimed.

Bow means visible hull nose contour; stern points where supplied are visible aft lower hull corners, not inferred centerline transom centers. This convention can differ from centerline endpoint labeling.
Null means the actual hull endpoint could not be reliably separated from motor, rider or spray. Do not interpolate null values as measured endpoints.
Obstructed=true denotes an endpoint left unknown due to overlap/ambiguity; false does not imply a perfectly sharp or wholly unobstructed boat.
Perspective, compression blur, spray, hull roll and short hull size limit repeatability. Entry bow locations also have approximately 5-10 px visual uncertainty.
